integrity: The proof is self-contained after the standard definition of ultrapower and the cited definition of rigid octahedrality; no computational or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on the existence of a free countably complete ultrafilter; no existence or consistency assertion is made.
The diagonal-collapse mechanism is known; the claimed contribution is the explicit sharpness consequence for recent octahedral ultrapower rigidification.
No claim is made about countably incomplete ultrafilters, where the positive theorem remains in force.
title: Countable incompleteness is conditionally sharp for octahedral ultrapowers
